description: Inject the full memory protocol, gate work on verified reads, and reject incomplete turns.

hooks.command: python3 -c 'import os,pathlib,re,runpy,sys; root=os.environ.get("PLUGIN_ROOT"); not root and (sys.stderr.write("HyperMemory PLUGIN_ROOT missing\n") and sys.exit(2)); base=pathlib.Path(root).parent; candidates=[p for p in base.glob("*/scripts/hypermemory_hook.py") if p.is_file()]; script=max(candidates,key=lambda p:tuple(int(x) for x in re.findall(r"\d+",p.parent.parent.name)),default=None); script is None and (sys.stderr.write("HyperMemory hook missing\n") and sys.exit(2)); os.environ["PLUGIN_ROOT"]=str(script.parent.parent); sys.argv=[str(script),sys.argv[1]]; runpy.run_path(str(script),run_name="__main__")' session-start
